ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: There is such a utility pole in Yingze Park: a cable goes from north to south, winds around the utility pole, and turns to go from east to west. The contact point between the cable and the utility pole is P. One end of the steel cable fixing the utility pole is fixed at point P, and the other end is fixed on the ground; the steel cable, the utility pole, and the east-west direction cable are in the same vertical plane. Suppose the cable is horizontal; the pulling forces exerted on the utility pole by the north-south and east-west direction cables are respectively $F_1,F_2$, and their magnitudes are equal; the pulling force exerted on the utility pole by the steel cable is $F_3$. It is known that the utility pole planted in the soil is vertical. Which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The direction of the resultant force of $F_1,F_2$ and $F_3$ in the horizontal plane is biased toward the north side
